outputs_plan.title: Executive Summary: Operation Silver Falcon Incident Response
outputs_plan.target_audience: Leadership, CISO, and Government cybersecurity and security operations teams
outputs_plan.tone: Professional, factual and concise with high-level strategic clarity
outputs_plan.communication_objective: Brief leadership on incident scope, operational impact, and risk posture (Awareness and response)
mandatory_elements: Incident Overview and Severity classification (SEVERITY-HIGH)
Exact operational disruption window (47 minutes)
Affected systems enumeration (PORTAL-01, APP-02, AUTH-01)
Current containment status (services restored as of 03:22 UTC)
Explicit statement that attribution remains UNCONFIRMED
prohibited_elements: Speculative attribution to named threat groups
Deep forensic terminal syntax or low-level exploit payloads
validation_rules: Disruption duration must equal canonical claim value (47 minutes)
Attribution must state UNCONFIRMED
Affected systems must list PORTAL-01, APP-02, and AUTH-01
Contains all required executive sections

outputs_plan.title: Technical Security Advisory: Session Replay & Infrastructure Hardening (SEC-ADV-2026-0417)
outputs_plan.target_audience: Government cybersecurity and security operations teams
outputs_plan.tone: Professional, factual and concise - highly structured, technical, and actionable
outputs_plan.communication_objective: Technical mitigation and defensive posture enhancement (Awareness and response)
mandatory_elements: Advisory Title, CVE/Case ID, Severity (SEVERITY-HIGH)
Incident Summary and Initial Access Vector (admin-research session replay)
Indicators of Compromise: IPv4 185.203.117.42, tool falcon_pipe (MD5: e4d909c290d0fb1ca068ffaddf22cbd0)
Technical Impact across PORTAL-01, APP-02, AUTH-01
Actionable Recommendations (FIDO2 MFA, network segmentation, Kerberos KRBTGT rotation)
Confidence / Attribution status (strictly UNCONFIRMED)
validation_rules: Must include all confirmed IoCs (IP, account, malware hash)
Must include concrete mitigation steps
Attribution must be explicitly unconfirmed
Disruption duration must match canonical duration

outputs_plan.title: Public Awareness & Community Incident Disclosure Post
outputs_plan.target_audience: General public, technology community, and platform users
outputs_plan.tone: Professional, factual and concise - transparent, reassuring, and concise
outputs_plan.communication_objective: Public transparency, reassure data integrity, and announce service restoration (Awareness and response)
mandatory_elements: Acknowledgment of 47-minute service disruption on the Research Portal
Confirmation of rapid containment and full service restoration at 03:22 UTC
Confirmation that core database integrity was maintained
Commitment to security transparency
prohibited_elements: Exaggerated or alarming claims beyond verified facts
validation_rules: Length within platform constraints (under 280 words)
Disruption duration strictly matches canonical duration (47 minutes)
No speculative attribution
No disclosure of sensitive internal account identifiers

outputs_plan.title: Incident Briefing Deck: Operation Silver Falcon Response & Lessons Learned
outputs_plan.target_audience: Technical Steering Committee, CISO, and Operations Review Board
outputs_plan.tone: Professional, factual and concise - structured, analytical, and visually organized
outputs_plan.communication_objective: Structured briefing covering chronology, technical findings, and long-term remediation (Awareness and response)
mandatory_elements: Slide 1: Incident Overview & Classification
Slide 2: Chronological Timeline (01:58 UTC to 03:22 UTC)
Slide 3: Affected Systems & Operational Impact (47 minutes)
Slide 4: Technical Findings & Indicators of Compromise
Slide 5: Response, Current Containment & Hardening
Evidence/Claim IDs mapped to each slide
prohibited_elements: Unmapped factual assertions lacking claim references
validation_rules: Must contain exactly 5 structured slides matching standard agenda
All slides must reference relevant canonical claim IDs
Disruption duration must equal 47 minutes
Attribution must state UNCONFIRMED

outputs_plan.title: Video Briefing Script: Operation Silver Falcon Quick-Response Overview
outputs_plan.target_audience: Security staff, internal agency personnel, and technical researchers
outputs_plan.tone: Professional, factual and concise - clear, engaging, authoritative, and spoken-word natural
outputs_plan.communication_objective: Audiovisual briefing summarizing the event, containment success, and security takeaways (Awareness and response)
mandatory_elements: Structured scenes with scene number, estimated duration in seconds, visual cue, spoken narration, on-screen text
Scene covering initial detection at 02:14 UTC
Scene covering 47-minute disruption window and containment at 03:22 UTC
Scene covering hardening and current secure operating state
Explicit spoken confirmation that attribution is unconfirmed
prohibited_elements: Discrepancies in timeline or outage duration (e.g. stating 74 minutes instead of 47 minutes)
validation_rules: Total runtime between 60 to 90 seconds
All scenes must include visual and narration fields
Disruption duration spoken and on-screen must be exactly 47 minutes
Attribution unconfirmed

cross_output_consistency_rules: RULE-01: Disruption Duration Consistency - All outputs referencing disruption must state exactly 47 minutes (or the exact value in CLM-001).
RULE-02: Attribution Integrity - No output may claim or infer a specific threat actor or nation-state; attribution must remain UNCONFIRMED.
RULE-03: Entity Integrity - All references to systems must use canonical identifiers: PORTAL-01, APP-02, AUTH-01.
RULE-04: Timeline Consistency - Detection at 02:14 UTC, disruption from 02:35 to 03:22 UTC, full restoration at 03:22 UTC.
RULE-05: IoC Consistency - All technical outputs referencing attacker ingress must use IP 185.203.117.42.
